decisions.reason: As a newly launched and prominently featured product, it still has option value after only one selling season and the evidence is not yet strong enough to justify abandonment.

Its home-page placement suggests meaningful early promise, and for an established seasonal wood-products firm the cost of keeping it for another season is likely modest relative to the remaining upside.
This appears to be a core new platform product with complementary add-ons, so management would likely preserve the option until more market feedback arrives.
Although only mentioned rather than highlighted, it is a complementary accessory to Product C and is likely inexpensive to keep on offer while demand uncertainty resolves.
This seasonal variant looks more niche than the main products, but its likely low carrying cost means it is still worth keeping for another season before making a final exit decision.
Its prominent presentation indicates initial strategic importance, and after just one year the firm would usually keep this themed product to learn more about repeat seasonal demand.
